verdict.rationale: Viam does not document a native natural-language task interface. It does document that an external AI agent with a shell or SDK can operate a machine, with the CLI calling any API method using JSON in and out. Its motion service then plans and executes collision-free paths toward goal poses, so the platform supplies the planning and execution layer while the user's own agent has to translate language into calls. Missing for 10: a first-party natural-language-to-task interface, built-in task-level (not just motion) planning from language, and hands-on or independent corroboration of agent-driven operation.
